title: यो जितः नं देश यो तर जिं मखं जिगु देश गो म्येय् संकथनीय दृष्टिकोण Yo Jita: nam Desha yo tara Jim makham Jigu Desha Go Myem Sankathaniya Drishtikon
nepali: स्वच्छन्दवादी कवि दुर्गालाल श्रेष्ठया नेपालभाषा साहित्यय् त्वःफिके मज्यूगु नां खः । कवितायात संगीतात्मक, माधुर्य, कोमलता व सरलतां जाःगु काव्य रचना यानाः थःगु म्हसीका बियादीम्ह कवि दुर्गालाल जनवादी साहित्य रचनाय् नं न्ह्यःने लाः । राज्यसत्तां यानाच्वंगु असहज परिस्थितियात खबरदारी याय्कथं च्वसा न्ह्याकाः वयाच्वंम्ह कविं थुगु कविताय् देशय् च्वनाः नं देशया अनुभूति याय्मखंगुया पीडा बोध दु । पंचायती व्यवस्थाया परिवेशय् च्वःगु थुगु कविताय् अनागरिक जुयाच्वंपिनिगु पीडाया लिसें असमानता वअन्याययात माधुर्यपूर्वक न्ह्यःने हःगु दु । शव्दं नं विद्रोहया शंखघोष याय्फु धइ थें जाःगु अभिव्यक्तिं जाःगु शव्द छ्यलातःगु थ्व कविताय् विद्रोहं हे देश निर्माणया भूमिका तयार जुइ धइगु भावना दुथ्याः । ल्यत्तुल्यया सितिं मवंक छ्यलातःगु शव्दया लिधँसाय् च्वयातःगु थ्व कविता शोषित पीडितपिनिगु वकालत याय्त नं छ्यःगु दु । जि पात्र अर्थात सर्वनामयात प्रतिनिधित्व याकाः मनोवाद शैलीं च्वयातःगु थ्व कवितायात म्वाय्कं भूमिका नंबियातःगु मदु । थुकिं यानाः वैचारिक आन्दोलन, शोषित व गरीव जनताया प्रतिनिधित्व यानाः च्वयातःगु थुगु कविता वैचारिक कविताया धलखय् कोशल्वहंकथं नाले बहजू ।
american_english: Romantic poet Durgalal Shrestha is an unforgettable name in Nepal Bhasa literature. Having established his identity by composing poetic works imbued with musicality, sweetness, tenderness, and simplicity, poet Durgalal is also at the forefront of progressive literary creation. In this poem, the poet, who has wielded his pen to caution against the uneasy conditions created by the state authority, conveys the aching realization of being unable to feel one's country despite living in it. Composed against the backdrop of the Panchayat system, this poem gracefully brings forth inequality and injustice alongside the suffering of those relegated to non-citizenship. Employing diction laden with expressions suggesting that words themselves can sound the clarion call of rebellion, this poem embodies the sentiment that rebellion alone prepares the ground for nation-building. Written on the foundation of words chosen with meticulous care without letting them go to waste, this poem is also utilized to advocate for the exploited and oppressed. Written in a monologue style representing the persona "Ji" (I), that is, the first-person pronoun, this poem is not weighed down by any artificial pretense. Consequently, composed as a representation of ideological movements and of the exploited and impoverished populace, this poem deserves to be acknowledged as a milestone in the annals of ideological poetry.
